searchText: I'm inheriting Geth's original implementation and in Geth, it doesn't remove txs after get payload call. Gotcha. Geth removes txs from its mempool when they are included in a new block received via the network, not after a `getPayload` call. Makes sense for `getInclusionListTxs` to follow Yes, it runs a loop that updates mempool when head is changed, if my understanding is not wrong. It looks good! I've left some questions and comment. nice! left some comments as well Thanks all. Addressed the comments Today/tomorrow I will update prysm focil branch to properly use focil_epoch / focil_version. Happy to maintain other branches that overload electra or overload fulu as well. But I think for long term success, we want to use focil_epoch / focil_version
